passkeys-2.4.0.js is the unmodified web runtime required by the installed
passkeys_web 2.9.0 plugin (a transitive authentication dependency).

Source: https://github.com/corbado/flutter-passkeys/releases/download/2.4.0/bundle.js
Project: https://github.com/corbado/flutter-passkeys

It is loaded before Flutter plugin registration. Keep it pinned to the version
required by passkeys_web when updating dependencies. Embedded third-party
copyright and license notices are preserved in the distributed file.
